fullBio: I am Ikhwan Ramadhan, a Computer Science graduate (B.S. in Informatics Engineering) from Universitas Putra Indonesia “YPTK” Padang (GPA: 3.26 / 4.00). My primary specialization centers on frontend web engineering within the React, Next.js, and TypeScript ecosystem. I cultivate a T-shaped engineering profile: deep proficiency in responsive component architecture, client-side state management (Zustand, Angular Signals), server-state synchronization and API integration (TanStack Query, Axios), declarative form validation (Zod), and role-based authentication (NextAuth, RBAC, JWT), complemented by adaptive full-stack competence in PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Prisma ORM.

These technical competencies were developed through institutional production delivery and independent software projects. During my internship at SMP Negeri 24 Padang, I developed the official school web portal using Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS with an integrated CMS, built a school Waste Bank module capable of incremental student deposit tracking and automated monthly PDF reporting, and enforced role-based access control (RBAC) connected to internal APIs. In independent work, I built an automotive commerce platform featuring automated lead queue distribution to sales agents with direct WhatsApp integration.

Within my academic research, I bridged computational modeling and web interface engineering for my undergraduate thesis on tropical cyclone trajectory forecasting using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. Following the empirical evaluation of 12 experimental scenarios (achieving a mean Haversine error of 14.2 km and an R² of 0.999), I converted the optimal model to ONNX format for direct in-browser execution via ONNX Runtime on an interactive map built with Astro Island Architecture.

Across every engineering assignment, I emphasize code readability, strict type contracts, and deliberate rendering optimization (SSR, SSG, ISR). Combining self-directed learning discipline with clear team communication, I am prepared to contribute effectively within a software engineering team.
